parole.significato: boat (small vehicle for transporting people, goods, etc. on water)
parole.testo: Cognates include Lithuanian lai̇̃vas, dialectal lai̇̃vė, archaic lai̇̃va. The relationship by borrowing to Proto-Finnic *laiva (Finnish laiva “ship; nave”, Estonian laev, Livonian lōja) is also undisputed, leaving the question of which family had the word first.
